Since childhood I have heard the stories about the #BayofPigs invasion as recounted by many of the participants themselves, many of them close friends of my father. These men have never tired of sharing anecdotes of their patriotic deed—in which more than 100 Cuban young men made the ultimate sacrifice for their dream to see #Cuba free again.
It is always a pleasure to spend time with you, draw inspiration from your experiences, and learn about our shared past. We will never forget what you did.
I want to thank Attorney General Ashley Moody for inviting me to honor and listen, yet again, to the first-hand accounts from these great heroes, who are not only a historical point of reference for the Cuban community, but who continue to remain steadfast in their commitment to the cause of freedom. Today, as we gathered at the Bay of Pigs Museum, we paid our respects to these veterans, and in the process became better acquainted with the men all of us in the exile community consider both our #heroes and our family.
Desde pequeña he escuchado las historias de Bahía de Cochinos en la voz de sus protagonistas, veteranos, amigos cercanos de mi padre que siempre nos cuentan sus anécdotas sobre aquel gesto patriótico que le costó la vida a más de 100 jóvenes cubanos soñando por la libertad de Cuba.
Siempre es un placer compartir con ustedes, inspirarme con sus vivencias y aprender de nuestro pasado.
Gracias a la Fiscal General Ashley Moody por invitarme a honrar y escuchar las historias de estos grandes héroes que no sólo son un referente histórico para la comunidad cubana, también son grandes #DefensoresDeLaLibertad y hoy, desde el Museo de #BahíadeCochinos, hemos rendido homenaje y conocido un poco más sobre sus heroicas vidas.

## Anti-Socialism
Freedom and the pursuit of the American Dream is at stake as leaders in Congress on the left want to implement socialism in this country. Our community, more than most in our nation, know the horrors and injustices of socialism. Socialism isn’t a romantic ideal as those on the left want us to believe. Failed socialism systems have brought misery, oppression, and exile to the countries from which many in our community fled. Maria is fighting to preserve and protect the freedoms and values that make this country the most extraordinary country in the history of the world. Socialism is flawed, dangerous, and has no place in the United States of America. It is unfathomable that those on the left believe it’s a viable option. We must not remain silent. We must continue to fight socialism. Those who sit idly by in the face of oppression are complicit its devastating effects.
## Economy & Jobs
The economy is recovering quickly, but many in our communities still don’t have enough opportunities to succeed. Today, Hispanics and African-Americans are joining the labor force in impressive numbers, and the low-wage earner is getting paid better than just a few years ago. We need to continue the momentum and build on the economic policies in place that are working for all Americans. That's why Maria opened a Prosperity Center in her congressional office. The Prosperity Center connects people with job opportunities, creates access to job skills training, and helps small businesses become contractors to the government.
Maria is fighting so everyone can pursue their own American Dream.
## Term Limits
We must get rid of career politicians in both parties that put profits and power above people, and we must set limits on how long public servants can serve in Washington. Our Founding Fathers intended it to be: public service, not a career. Today, Washington is full of career politicians who have lost touch with their constituents, who believe their primary objective is to get re-elected. They enrich themselves and cultivate powerful connections that in turn fund their campaigns.
## Affordable Healthcare
Americans need to be able to access affordable healthcare. There must be protections for people with pre-existing conditions, we must take care of our seniors and protect Medicare, and young adults should be allowed to stay on their parents’ plan up to the age of 26. In order to lower costs, we need more competition, including allowing individuals and families to buy health insurance across state lines. The government can and should renegotiate drug prices to lower the high cost of medications. The high premiums, co-payments, and medication make impossible what every American cannot be without: affordable healthcare.
## Protect the Environment
Climate change is real, and the evidence is right here in Miami. Miami’s pristine coastline must be protected. The water level is rising in at an alarming rate and coastal areas like Miami Beach may become uninhabitable in a matter of decades, not centuries, unless we work to combat the problem. As studies have shown, Miami will need some major feats of engineering, way beyond the resources available at the state and local levels. Maria is working to secure federal funding and bring to South Florida the best engineering minds to tackle the threats that we face from climate change and preserve Miami Beach. Maria is ensuring our dated drainage and waste processing systems are modernized and reliable so that the flooding endemic to our area is less of a threat.
## Education & Schools
Maria is a product of South Florida’s public school system. She paid her way through the University of Miami and Harvard graduate school. All children must have access to the greatest education system possible.

## National Association of Police Organizations (NAPO) Endorses María Elvira Salazar For Congress
August 22 2022
Today, the National Association of Police Organizations (NAPO) endorsed María Elvira Salazar for re-election to represent Florida’s 27th Congressional district. The endorsement was based on the recommendation of their member organization, the Florida Police Benevolent Association.
“On behalf of the National Association of Police Organizations (NAPO), I am very pleased to formally announce NAPO’s endorsement of [Rep. Salazar’s] re-election campaign for United States House of Representatives,” said Michael McHale, President of NAPO. “NAPO […] is confident [she] will continue [her] support of the law enforcement community in Congress.”
“The Democrats’ anti-police rhetoric has led to a major decline in police retention and even higher crime,” said Rep. Salazar. “As the daughter of Cuban exiles, I firmly support the rule of law and those who enforce it. Since coming to Congress, I’ve worked hard to support our law enforcement and provide them with the tools they need to make our communities safer. I’m proud to receive NAPO’s endorsement and look forward to continuing to work with our law enforcement to reduce crime here in Miami.”
Salazar has previously been endorsed by former United Nations Ambassador and Governor Nikki Haley, former Secretary of State and CIA director Mike Pompeo, and current U.S. Senator Tim Scott.

## Small Business and the Economy
“As a member of the House Small Business Committee, I am dedicated to supporting Miami’s “Mom and Pop” shops by championing initiatives to cut red tape, enhance access to capital, and increase competition with larger corporations. My commitment extends to fostering economic growth and ensuring small businesses thrive, which drives innovation and job creation in our communities. I am also focused on reducing unnecessary federal spending.” – María Elvira Salazar
Below are some of my key accomplishments:
$3 Million for the Renovation of Miami-Dade College Historic Dyer Federal Courthouse: Secured funding to revitalize this historic landmark into a vibrant center for workforce development, innovation, and cultural enrichment.
My COVID Economic (EIDL) Relief Act implemented into law: This bill gave small business owners extra time to pay back loans, helping them rebuild and grow after the COVID pandemic.
Passed Amendment to Expand Contracting Opportunities for Small Businesses: This amendment increases the limits for sole source contracting, and expands opportunities for veteran-owned, women-owned, and minority-owned businesses. Also, by improving access to government contracts, it supports the growth of small and disadvantaged businesses, driving broader economic recovery and growth.
My RECLAIM Taxpayer Funds Act was Implemented by SBA: This legislation recovers billions from fraudulent government loans, ensuring fiscal responsibility and addressing misuse of COVID-19 relief funds. By reclaiming these funds, we are also working to help reduce inflation across the country.
$650,000 Secured for BizGap Program at FIU: Funding will support the BizGap program, offering essential consulting and training to over 1,000 small businesses in District 27, fostering job creation and business growth.
Organized Job Fairs and Small Business Expos: I Hosted numerous events to connect South Florida talent with local employers and support the development of small businesses.
Conducted Educational Seminars for Constituents and Federal Agencies: I provided dozens of valuable seminars on a range of topics including tax filing, business startups, and federal contracting.
Capital Support for Small Businesses: I cosponsored the Main Street Tax Certainty Act to permanently extend the 20% tax deduction for small businesses, preventing them from having to limit their growth, investment, and hiring plans.
Reducing Red Tape: I co-sponsored the Small Business Regulatory Reduction Act, which mandates that any new SBA regulation must not impose costs on small businesses. I’ve also sent numerous letters to the SBA questioning their proposed costly regulations.
Supporting the Fiscal Responsibility Act: I backed the Fiscal Responsibility Act, which cuts over $2 trillion in spending, reclaims $28 billion in unspent COVID funds, and expands welfare work requirements. This historic measure aims to be the largest deficit reduction bill ever.

## Protecting the Environment and our Natural Resources

## En las Noticias: María Elvira Salazar impulsará el “Plan Dignidad” ante el Congreso para beneficiar a inmigrantes en EEUU (+ VIDEO)
September 29 2022
La congresista por el distrito 27 de Florida, María Elvira Salazar , impulsará junto a otros representantes republicanos en el Congreso de EEUU, un proyecto llamado “Plan Dignidad” con el cual se busca beneficiar a los inmigrantes indocumentados radicados en ese país.
La cubanoamericana reiteró que, actualmente se vive una severa crisis en la frontera con México por lo que urgió a la administración de Joe Biden a encontrar soluciones concretas al asunto.
En ese sentido, María Elvira Salazar precisó que, el Plan Dignidad estará dirigido a los inmigrantes que tienen más de cinco años en Estados Unidos y que no tienen un estatus migratorio legal.
La congresista apuntó que, con este proyecto se busca “darle un camino de dignidad” por 10 años a aquellos inmigrantes que tengan más de cinco años en Estados Unidos, que tienen hijos americanos. “Que han pagado impuestos, que no han cometido ningún crimen y que han contribuido a la salud económica de este país, darle dignidad y no esperar más por la llamada ciudadanía”, agregó.
María Elvira Salazar consideró que, la reforma migratoria presentada por la administración Biden no es una realidad ya que no cuenta ni siquiera con los votos necesarios para ser aprobada en el Senado.
Cabe recordar que, recientemente la congresista viajó a la frontera con México para constatar de primera mano la crisis que se vive en esa zona con la llegada masiva de migrantes que buscan entrar a Estados Unidos ilegalmente.

pages.title: Issues - Maria Elvira Salazar for Congress
pages.text:
## Infrastructure
As your representative in Congress, I have secured millions of dollars in federal funding to modernize and strengthen South Florida’s infrastructure. My work has delivered critical investments in flood mitigation, stormwater management, road and bridge improvements, water and sewer upgrades, coastal resilience, and port infrastructure. From expanding Port of Miami’s capacity and reducing emissions to replacing aging water systems, improving mobility corridors, and protecting neighborhoods from flooding, these projects are making our communities safer, more resilient, and better prepared for future growth. I remain committed to ensuring South Florida has the modern infrastructure needed to support a strong economy, protect our quality of life, and meet the challenges of the 21st century.
## Anti-Socialism
As your representative in Congress, I have been one of the strongest voices in Washington against socialism, communism, and authoritarian regimes. Having witnessed firsthand the devastation these ideologies have caused across Latin America, I have led the fight to defend freedom, democracy, and human rights. I have held congressional hearings exposing the abuses of the Cuban, Maduro, and Ortega regimes, championed sanctions against dictators and their enablers, and fought to keep pressure on those who oppress their own people. I have also spoken out against attacks on free speech and democratic institutions in countries like Brazil and worked to ensure transparency and accountability in elections across the region, including Honduras. From passing legislation to strengthen America's response to authoritarian threats to standing with political prisoners and pro-democracy activists, my commitment is unwavering: defending liberty, confronting tyranny, and ensuring the voices of those fighting for freedom are heard.
## Economy & Jobs
As your representative in Congress, I am working to create more opportunities for South Florida families, support local businesses, and keep our economy strong. I have voted to lower taxes, supported efforts to provide greater tax relief for working families, and fought to help small businesses grow and create jobs. I have also worked to recover billions of taxpayer dollars lost to fraud and waste during the pandemic, helping bring greater accountability to government spending and reduce inflationary pressures. In addition, I have secured funding for workforce training programs and hosted five major job fairs, connecting thousands of South Florida residents with employers and helping people find good jobs close to home. My focus is simple: creating opportunity, supporting workers and small businesses, and building a stronger economy for every family in South Florida.
## Term Limits
We must get rid of career politicians in both parties that put profits and power above people, and we must set limits on how long public servants can serve in Washington. Our Founding Fathers intended it to be: public service, not a career. Today, Washington is full of career politicians who have lost touch with their constituents, who believe their primary objective is to get re-elected. They enrich themselves and cultivate powerful connections that in turn fund their campaigns.
## Affordable Healthcare
As your representative in Congress, I am committed to strengthening our healthcare system and ensuring patients have access to the care they need. I have secured millions of dollars to expand healthcare services, strengthen hospitals, support groundbreaking medical research, and improve access to care for children, seniors, and underserved communities. I have helped expand mental health services for children, supported advances in cancer research and personalized medicine, and worked to ensure families have access to the treatments they need. I also fought to protect and preserve programs that train the next generation of doctors, helping expand the healthcare workforce and improve access to care in communities that need it most. In addition, I have helped seriously ill children receive life-saving medical treatment in Miami and championed policies that put patients and families first. My goal is simple: to improve access to care, strengthen our healthcare system, and help every family live healthier lives.
## Protect the Environment
As a proud champion of the Everglades, I am fully committed to securing funding for its restoration and preservation, ensuring this unique ecosystem is protected for generations to come. I am leading the charge to create a National Resilience Strategy, designed to safeguard our coastal communities from the increasing threats of hurricanes, storm surges, and rising sea levels. I’ve secured millions of dollars through Community Funding Projects for Florida’s 27th district to build critical stormwater infrastructure, reduce flooding, and improve water quality in Biscayne Bay. Additionally, I passed legislation to support coral reef restoration, including the transformation of retired Navy ships into artificial reefs, which not only strengthens our marine ecosystems but also boosts local economies and recreational opportunities. From combating harmful algae blooms to advocating for clean water initiatives, my focus remains on protecting our environment and enhancing Florida’s natural resources for a sustainable future.
